earlier_runs: reference-run-001 passed the same gates on cluster pg-001, whose time zone was the host zone, not UTC as toolchain.json postgresql.cluster requires; run 002 repeats it on a UTC cluster and is the recorded run.
gates_command_note: Each command is the toolchain.json command as run, with node and npm resolved to the pinned binaries. The raw .local gates.json record dropped the leading node.
reference_product_notes: The reference product is a toolchain probe for amendment 001, not the renderer's template. These limits, found by the independent review, are left for the renderer and parity acceptance:
src/main.ts: a second SIGINT or SIGTERM calls pool.end() again, which rejects unhandled and exits 1; the server.close error is ignored.
src/main.ts: no pool error listener, so an idle client error stops the process.
src/main.ts: SOM_APP_ADDR accepts any host text; a host that cannot be bound fails at listen with exit 1, not 2.

src/db.ts: every SQLSTATE class 23 error maps to 409, while product-layout.json names 23505 (and 23503 for v5); PATCH with title null reaches 409 through NOT NULL (23502), not compared with Python here.
src/app.ts: the json_invalid loc position is a UTF-16 index; Python reports a code point index.
